title: Megan Thee Stallion Names Priyanka Chopra Jonas Her Honorary Victoria's Secret Angel
excerpt: Fresh off closing the 2026 Victoria's Secret Fashion Show in silver wings, Megan said she wants the Bollywood star on the runway: 'She is tea'
body:
• Megan Thee Stallion named Priyanka Chopra Jonas her "honorary angel" and said she wants the actor on the Victoria's Secret runway, Hindustan Times reported, calling her "tea."
  • Megan closed the 2026 Victoria's Secret Fashion Show on October 18 in Culver City, performing "Her" and "Body" in silver Angel wings.
  • The night fulfilled a wish Megan first posted about as a teenager; on the pink carpet she called it "so full circle."
  • There has been no casting announcement from Victoria's Secret or Priyanka, so for now the invitation exists only as Megan's public wish.

Megan Thee Stallion has picked the star she wants beside her on fashion's most famous runway: Priyanka Chopra Jonas. Hindustan Times reported that Megan named the Indian actor her "honorary angel" and said she wants her on the Victoria's Secret runway, summing her up in one word: "She is tea." The comment, made around Megan's own debut as an Angel at the 2026 Victoria's Secret Fashion Show, is an invitation, not a casting: neither Victoria's Secret nor Priyanka has announced anything, and Priyanka has not walked the show before.

The Night Megan Got Her Own Wings

Megan closed the 2026 Victoria's Secret Fashion Show on Sunday, October 18, at Sony Pictures Studios in Culver City, California, performing "Her" and then "Body" during the show's Winter Reprise segment, Just Jared reported. She performed in silver Angel wings and sparkling stockings, after arriving on the pink carpet in a sheer, sequin-adorned custom Walter Mendez Atelier gown with a pink feathery train, according to Page Six. The all-female performance lineup also featured Tate McRae, KATSEYE and Megan Moroney.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=1vvMhlXSJZ0

"I feel like everybody has seen that I've been tweeting about this since I was like 14," she told Scott Evans on the pink carpet, in comments carried by Just Jared."

For Megan, the booking closed a loop that began in her teens. "This is so unreal. This is so full circle. I feel like everybody has seen that I've been tweeting about this since I was like 14," she told Scott Evans on the pink carpet, in comments carried by Just Jared. "I came to eat. I came to devour and that's what I'm going to do on the runway," she added. When her place in the show was announced weeks earlier, she had written on Instagram: "HOTTIES MY DREAM HAS FINALLY COME TRUE!!!! I'M IN THEE VICTORIA'S SECRET FASHION SHOWWWW ... TUNE IN OCTOBER 18 TO SEE ME GET MY WINGSSS."

Why the Priyanka Pick Lands With Diaspora Fans

Priyanka is the obvious crossover name for an American spectacle watched around the world: an Indian superstar who now works on both sides of the industry, headlining Hollywood productions while remaining one of Bollywood's biggest faces. For Indian and diaspora viewers, who form a large part of the global audience for both Megan's music and the Victoria's Secret broadcast, the shout-out reads as more than flattery. It places an Indian actor at the centre of a US pop-culture institution at the exact moment Megan herself was being inducted into it. Megan's choice also fits the show's recent direction, pairing its runway with performers such as Rihanna and Taylor Swift in past years and rebuilding the Angel lineup for a broader audience.

What Happens Next

Nothing is confirmed. The next Victoria's Secret lineup will be the brand's call, and Priyanka has given no public response in the reports so far. Until then, diaspora readers can judge Megan's own Angel credentials directly: the full performances from the October 18 show are available to rewatch on the Victoria's Secret YouTube channel, according to Just Jared. If Priyanka ever does take the runway, Megan has already written her introduction.
